proposals.title: Fix CanonicalEncoder: capture Number constants and produce full validation evidence
proposals.why_now: TASK-0006 was rejected in its third and final review for exactly two MAJOR findings: (1) capturedParseInt10 in canonical.ts reads Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and Number.NaN from the live global at call time rather than capturing them as module-level constants at initialization, violating the zero-user-code-execution guarantee required by ADR-009 and the task acceptance criteria; (2) the validation evidence supplied no captured output of npm run compile or npm run boundary on the corrected candidate. packages/core/src/index.ts currently exports nothing, meaning no accepted implementation exists. StateHash cannot exist until the encoder is accepted, and every FASE-1 hash-dependent deliverable — INV-01, INV-22, the CI replay gate comparing StateHash tick by tick, tools/replay — is blocked on this acceptance. The two remaining issues are mechanical and narrowly scoped.

acceptance_targets: Money, Quantity, Price, and Rate defined as bigint branded types in packages/core with constructors that reject non-bigint input and values that are not integers.
Tick defined as a number branded type with a constructor rejecting non-integer and values outside [-(2^53-1), 2^53-1].
QUANTITY_SCALE = 100_000_000n, PRICE_SCALE = 10_000n, RATE_SCALE = 100_000_000n defined as bigint constants and exported.

A division helper exported from packages/core accepting explicit modes TRUNCATE_TOWARD_ZERO, ROUND_HALF_UP, and ROUND_HALF_EVEN, returning both quotient and residue; calling division without a mode is a compile-time or lint-level error enforced by the mechanism documented in ADR-004.
ADR-004 is written in docs/decisions/ specifying the chosen enforcement mechanism before implementation depends on it.
Unit tests cover constructor rejection paths and each division mode including residue correctness. Lint, compile, and boundary gates remain green.

proposals.title: Branded numeric types and division helper in packages/core (ADR-003 + ADR-004)
proposals.why_now: Every downstream FASE-1 component — ledger entries, price queries, order execution, tick-loop arithmetic, and RNG coordinates — must use the typed vocabulary defined by ADR-003 and ADR-004. Without Money, Quantity, Price, and Rate as bigint nominal wrappers and Tick as a safe-integer number nominal wrapper, implementing any of those subsystems forces a cross-cutting retrofit later. ADR-004 further requires that every division declares a rounding mode and that calling division without a mode is a compile error or lint error; establishing the enforcement mechanism now prevents undetected precision loss from accumulating across future domain code. This work is independent of the CanonicalEncoder and can proceed in parallel while IDEA-001 is in review.

proposals.title: Positional RNG with ADR specifying hash primitive bit-by-bit (ADR-002)
proposals.why_now: The price generator, macro event scheduler, bot policy derivation, NPC tip truth values, and venue liquidity all consume rand(masterSeed, namespace, ...coordinates). None of them can be implemented with correct INV-02 determinism until the hash primitive is specified bit-by-bit in an ADR and the pure rand() function is present in packages/core. ADR-002 marks the hash function as DEFINIR and recommends SplitMix64 over an FNV-1a accumulator; the ADR must be written before the implementation can exist. Without it no correctness test for the price generator is meaningful, because there is no specification of what the correct output should be.

proposals.title: Electron scaffolding with INV-29 security config and minimal installer (FASE-1 acceptance)
proposals.why_now: The FASE-1 acceptance criteria explicitly require a minimal installer for Windows and Linux produced by the CI, and a simulation already running in a dedicated worker outside the render thread with a typed message contract. INV-29 requires contextIsolation: true, nodeIntegration: false, and sandbox: true in all execution modes including development. The spec warns that if packaging appears late, native module ABI problems and cross-platform path issues emerge in the final week when there is no time to fix architecture. apps/desktop/main, preload, renderer, and simulation-worker exist as directories with stub index.ts files only. This work is independent of the CanonicalEncoder and of the numeric type and RNG work, and can proceed without blocking on either.

proposals.title: Minimal price generator: two assets, two noise octaves (FASE-1 core)
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance requires a working price generator covering at least two assets with two layers of noise, feeding the tick loop. The price generator is the primary consumer of the positional RNG and is needed before the ledger and order execution can be tested against realistic price inputs. Implementing it after the RNG (IDEA-003) delivers a complete and testable chain from rand() through price(asset, tick) and enables verification of INV-02 — the most important test in the project per the spec. Without price data no meaningful tick-loop or order-execution test can run. This proposal targets only the minimal two-asset, two-octave scope required by FASE-1; the full seven-asset, multi-layer generator belongs to FASE-2.

warnings: TASK-0006 has been rejected three times in sequence with overlapping MAJOR findings across TASK-0005 and TASK-0006. If the Implementer continues to supply summarized rather than captured validation evidence, the encoder will remain unaccepted regardless of code correctness. The planning agent should confirm that captured terminal output (exit code + full stdout/stderr) of npm run compile and npm run boundary is an explicit deliverable, not an optional detail.

docs/decisions/ contains no ADRs. ADR-009 (canonical encoding), ADR-002 (hash function bit-by-bit), ADR-003 (branded types), and ADR-004 (division modes and enforcement mechanism) are all DEFINIR or TRAVADO items that require ADRs before the implementation depending on them can be accepted. Every task that introduces implementation of these items must produce the corresponding ADR as a co-deliverable, or it will fail acceptance on that criterion.
